premises.text: Unethical businesses are eroding trust in the concept of free products
premises.evidence_span: unethical businesses are eroding our trust in the concept of free

premises.text: Users are missing out on great apps and services due to fear of free products
premises.evidence_span: for a lot of users, especially mainstream users, it's just not worth the risk of trying a free product

premises.text: A resource can help users find the best free products and avoid hidden catches
premises.evidence_span: if we could take that information that we all know about the great products that are out there and the ones with the hidden catches, that we would be able to organize that into a resource

premises.evidence_span: first thing you can do on Catch Free is a fast and easy verification whether a free product is safe

premises.text: Mainstream users enjoy exploring free products when they feel safe
premises.evidence_span: we saw that mainstream users, once they are not scared, they really love to explore

premises.text: Catch-Free will offer profitable CPAs to freemium businesses
premises.evidence_span: CatchFree is actually going to offer profitable CPAs to freemium businesses

premises.text: Users are in control with Catch-Free

value.text: Users can find safe and valuable free products easily
